claims.hypothesis: Can a spherically symmetric dust model reproduce the 2-1270 micron SED of the remnant?
claims.experiment: Manual RADMC-3D fits of single-shell, two-shell and two-shell-with-cavity models
claims.result: Best model cd1ol: M-type star with 0.012 Msun of dust in two shells reaching 1000 and 9500 AU
claims.finding: The SED is best replicated by a spherically symmetric two-shell model with a dust-free cavity

evidence.quote: We show that the SED is best replicated by a spherically symmetric model consisting of an M-type supergiant surrounded by 0.012 M$_{\odot}$ of dust concentrated within two spherical shells.

claims.hypothesis: Is the distance to BLG-360 smaller than the previous 8.2 kpc?

claims.hypothesis: Is the high near-IR opacity due to iron or to carbon grains?
claims.experiment: Compared models cd1dl and cd4dl differing only by iron versus amorphous carbon
claims.result: Carbon model gives too high opacity and no 10 micron feature
claims.finding: Solid iron grains are the more likely source of the NIR opacity

evidence.quote: Therefore, we conclude that our source of NIR opacities is more likely to be solid iron than carbon grains.
